job.label: Service pistol repaint — Masterwork
job.keep_line: the same single right-facing level side-view service pistol repaint, broad straight dark steel slide with its current angular front bevel, dark circular muzzle, three rear sloping serration cuts, rectangular upper-side port and small original top sights, stepped lower frame/dust cover, short rectangular trigger guard with its single curved trigger, and downward-sloping blue-grey inset grip panel secured by TWO round metal pins over the same dark grip base. Preserve every slide corner, port, sight, screw, trigger gap, under-frame step and grip angle; the magazine remains flush at the bottom. The original muted steel-blue grip inset stays at its current place. No accessory rail addition, optic, enlarged magazine, logo, lettering or external effect.
job.prompt:
Paint ONE Masterwork Service Pistol inventory icon for the fictional RPG Project Heaven Cry. This is only a2D digital painting. The first attachment is a technical reference pair: LEFT Standard fixes the exact geometry, pose, scale and framing; RIGHT Fine supplies the existing cleaned surfaces and engraved line. Render just one complete pistol, with no panel, label, second object or scene. Second attachment supplies Heavenprint brushwork only, no person.

The Masterwork appearance: keep all Fine additions. Paint the existing thin upper-side engraved contour as ONE continuous narrow muted steel-blue inlay in exactly its current route. The same steel-blue/grey grip inset looks like finer polished lacquer, with exactly the same shape and TWO round pins. Existing trigger, small fittings and pins appear polished brass or bright steel in their original shapes. Clean unmarked metal, crisp refined edges and no wear. Same THREE rear diagonal cuts, all original openings and part positions, dark muzzle and side opening. No added ornament or repair. No part is added, removed, resized or moved.

Heavenprint opaque gouache and ink, broken directional brushstrokes and selective dry-brush, charcoal shadows, warm ivory focal edges, upper-left light. Keep a hand-painted surface, not a photo or3Drender. Transparent1024x1024RGBA canvas, same reference framing with at least50px clear margin. No ground, cast shadow, hand, person, text, letters, numbers, logos, real brands, border, frame, smoke, flash or external glow. Exterior artwork only; no diagram or instructions.
